title: Why Linux is making a comeback on desktop in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Linux is making a comeback because users demand control, security, and transparency—things Windows and macOS ignore. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Linux offers full customization, open-source drivers, and no bloatware—something proprietary OSes can’t match. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: With Wayland replacing X11 and Flatpak improving app distribution, Linux now supports modern desktop workflows better than ever. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Major companies like Red Hat and Canonical are investing heavily, pushing Linux into enterprise and creative workflows. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Linux isn’t just coming back—it’s leading the future of desktop computing. (4 sec)
